speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth's (MCCY) mission is to build social capital and inspire the Singapore Spirit.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: COVID-19 is impacting us in many ways, reminding us that social cohesion and a strong spirit of civic responsibility are more important than ever before.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: In this new term of Government, MCCY will continue to work with Singaporeans to build a home that is caring, cohesive, and confident.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will step up our community and youth engagement efforts, while continuing to develop a vibrant arts, heritage, and sports landscape that Singaporeans can enjoy and be proud of.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: MCCY will continue to help Singaporeans stay connected and support each other through the crisis.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The SG Cares Volunteer Centres complement the efforts of our community organisations to care for vulnerable groups, by coordinating volunteerism efforts on the ground.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Religious organisations are also giving spiritual guidance and comfort to their communities, working with us to put in place measures to keep their worshippers safe.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Together, we have and will continue to adopt new ways to connect with those in need of support, such as phone calls, tele-conferencing, contactless delivery of essential goods, and digital platforms for religious worship.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We also created traineeship and internship opportunities for youths in the community and social sectors, enabling them to pick up work-ready competencies while giving back to society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We have seen Singaporeans showing empathy, social responsibility, and neighbourliness – values and behaviours that underpin a cohesive and caring society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: More ground-up movements are emerging to propagate community-based initiatives for mutual support and we will support them.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We want to sustain this strong spirit of civic contribution and mutual care, even when COVID-19 is over.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through Youth Corps Singapore, Team Nila, and the People’s Association (PA) Youth Movement, and grants for ground-up projects, such as Our Singapore Fund, Our Harmony Fund, and the National Youth Fund, we will empower Singaporeans to create positive change in society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through the SG Cares movement, MCCY will continue working with partners and intermediaries to coordinate volunteerism efforts, build capabilities, channel resources to areas of need, and grow a more caring society together.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will continue to create opportunities for Singaporeans to come together and build shared memories with their communities, friends, and loved ones.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Even as the arts sector works to safely resume live performances, we will continue the #SGCultureAnywhere campaign so that Singaporeans can continue to enjoy the arts and culture.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will also continue to build and upgrade sports facilities, and offer affordable, quality ActiveSG programmes, so that Singaporeans can enjoy an active lifestyle and bond through sports.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through such platforms, Singaporeans with a passion for the arts and culture or sports will have access to opportunities to pursue their aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: With community partners, we will strengthen solidarity by providing opportunities for Singaporeans from different backgrounds to engage in respectful dialogue on sensitive issues of race and religion, both online and face-to-face.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will continue to enrich and grow our arts scene and cultivate our tangible and intangible heritage.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We look forward to the outcome of our nomination to inscribe Hawker Culture in Singapore on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, so we can proudly showcase our culture to the world.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Sports can inspire Singaporeans to rally together as a nation, and celebrate with our sporting heroes.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Through this, we can spur our athletes to greater heights.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: To strengthen the resilience of the community and social sectors over the longer term, we are partnering the National Council of Social Services (NCSS) and Tote Board to raise the digital capabilities of the local non-profit organisation sector, particularly the charities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will also raise the digital capabilities of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the arts, heritage, and sports sectors by leveraging SMEs Go Digital Programme, with support from the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and Enterprise Singapore (ESG).

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Due to the economic impact of COVID-19, the road ahead will not be an easy one for many of these organisations.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will invest in new capabilities that can help them lower costs, improve service delivery, and develop new and exciting products.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will also continue working with partners to strengthen peer support among youths in schools and the wider community.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: As part of the Youth Mental Well-being Network, we will support youths who want to initiate ground-up efforts to promote mental well-being.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: In 2018, we launched Our SG Arts Plan and Our SG Heritage Plan, setting out a 5-year roadmap for our sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We are reviewing these at the midpoint, drawing on the experiences, insights, and aspirations of the arts and heritage communities.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Similarly, in 2019 we launched V2030 Recharged, co-created in close collaboration with the sports community.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: These plans will support MCCY's vision to foster a caring people, cohesive society, and confident nation.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: Singaporeans have undergone a shared experience that has changed our lives.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We must reflect on and learn from what is happening, and how we can emerge stronger as a society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: These conversations will be an inclusive platform to discuss important bread-and-butter and key societal issues.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We invite Singaporeans to partner the Government to translate these reflections and ideas into action.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The SG Together Action Networks will bring together Government, community, and businesses, to cocreate solutions and lay the foundation for our vision of a stronger Singapore society.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: The current pandemic has underscored our duty to each other as fellow Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We came together to do our part, and demonstrated that we are a caring, inclusive society, that is united in the face of adversity.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: In this new term of Government, MCCY's agenda of policies and programmes will bolster this Singapore Spirit, and in partnership with Singaporeans, forge a stronger, more resilient society of mutual care and collective well-being.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
text: We will create a shared future by working together, as one people.
